purposes.title: For what purposes will we use your personal and/or sensitive data?

list: Contacting you to confirm and follow up on the services you contract or products you purchase through our site or our app;
Following up on or responding to any question, comment or suggestion you make through our app or website;
Communicating and informing you about any benefit or change in the services contracted by you;
Managing the delivery of orders and purchases made by you;
Data analysis activities through the website or app through the use of artificial intelligence and similar technologies for transactional analysis and processing;
Sending contact information to users of the Controller's websites or apps to achieve its purposes;
Having transactional visibility over your purchases and acquisitions for better service, and
Complying with the obligations contracted with you.
purposes.secondary: Additionally, we will use your personal information for the following secondary purposes that are not necessary for the requested service, but that allow us and facilitate providing you with better attention:
secondaryList: Delivery and shipment of promotional material of our own services and products or those of our business partners.
Delivery of information to third parties with whom we have commercial alliances,
Personalized commercial prospecting by offering our products and services, as well as any offer or promotion related to them, and
Statistical studies, such as surveys or studies on consumption and market habits;
purposes.optOut: In case you do not want your personal and/or sensitive data to be used for these secondary purposes, you may notify us through the following email address: support@circuitodigital.com.mx, where they will respond indicating the procedure to follow to exercise your rights. Your refusal to process your data in accordance with the Secondary Purposes does not represent a reason that prevents CircuitoDigital from providing the services or that leads us to terminate the established relationship.
purposes.collection: For the purposes indicated in this Privacy Notice, we may collect your personal data in different ways: when you provide it to us directly; when you visit our website or use our online services, in the activities you carry out within our facilities and when we obtain information through other sources that are permitted by applicable legislation and regulations. We collect your personal data directly when you provide it to us through various means, such as when you participate in our promotions or give us information so that we can provide you with a service. As well as the personal data we collect when you visit our website or use our online services or Personal Data we collect through other sources permitted by applicable legislation and regulations. We may obtain information about you from other sources permitted by law, such as Cookies, telephone or employment directories.

To carry out the purposes described in this privacy notice, we will use the following personal data:
list: Contact data, and in case you wish to contract CircuitoDigital services;

sharing.consent: Regarding transfers that require your consent, we require obtaining your express consent, which will be understood as granted if you accept this privacy notice by checking the corresponding box, after having read it. We commit to not transferring your personal information to third parties without your consent, except for the exceptions provided in article 37 of the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, as well as to carry out this transfer under the terms established by that law. Except in the cases established in article 37 of the aforementioned law, if you do not express your opposition for your Personal Data to be transferred, it will be understood that you have granted your consent for it.
sharing.commitment: CircuitoDigital commits to not transferring, sharing or transmitting your personal data to third parties without your prior consent, except when such transfer: (i) is necessary for the fulfillment or maintenance of a legal relationship between you and CircuitoDigital; (ii) is carried out between subsidiaries, affiliates and/or the parent company of CircuitoDigital; (iii) is required by competent authorities in the cases that are legally provided; or (iv) is legally required under current legislation and regulations.

In this sense, your information may be shared with subsidiaries, affiliates, controlling companies, shareholders, partners and third parties with whom we have commercial relationships, for the fulfillment of contractual obligations, requirements of competent authorities and those of our corporate purpose.
sharing.mechanism: We make available to you the mechanism described in the following section of this privacy notice so that, where applicable, you can communicate your refusal for such transfers to be carried out.

arco.title: How can you access, rectify or cancel your personal and/or sensitive data, or oppose its use?
arco.intro: You have the right to know what personal and/or sensitive data we have about you, what we use it for and the conditions of the use we give it (Access). Likewise, it is your right to request the correction of your personal information in case it is outdated, inaccurate or incomplete (Rectification); that we remove it from our records or databases when you consider that it is not being used properly (Cancellation); as well as to oppose the use of your personal and/or sensitive data for specific purposes (Opposition). These rights are known as ARCO Rights.
arco.procedure: To exercise any of the ARCO Rights, you must submit the respective request in writing, at the address of CircuitoDigital referred to above or through an email sent to the following address: support@circuitodigital.com.mx and addressed to the person in charge of the Personal Data Department of CircuitoDigital.
arco.requirements: The request referred to in the previous paragraph must contain: (i) name of the information holder, their address and email or other means to communicate the response; (ii) documents that prove their identity or the corresponding legal representation; (iii) clear and precise description of the personal data and/or sensitive personal data with respect to which the corresponding right is exercised; and (iv) any other element that facilitates the location of the personal and/or sensitive data. Regarding the procedure and requirements for the exercise of your ARCO Rights, we inform you the following:

items.label: a)
items.title: Through what means can the holder and, where applicable, their representative, as well as the latter's capacity, prove their identity?
items.text: In the case of the holder, through a simple copy of their valid official identification. In the case of acting through a representative, they must present a power of attorney that specifically authorizes them to exercise ARCO rights on behalf of the holder, signed by two witnesses, attaching copies of valid official identifications of the Holder, the representative and the witnesses. Similarly, a notarized power of attorney may be presented, attaching copies of valid official identifications of the Holder and the representative.

items.label: b)
items.title: What information and/or documentation must the request contain?
items.text: The clear and precise description of the personal data and/or sensitive personal data with respect to which the corresponding right is exercised, as well as any background that allows locating the corresponding data.

items.label: c)
items.title: In how many days will we respond to your request?
items.text: Within 20 (twenty) business days we will notify you of the admissibility of your request. If it is admissible, we will make your request effective within 15 (fifteen) calendar days following the day on which we notified you about the admissibility of your request.

items.label: d)
items.title: By what means will we communicate the response to your request?
items.text: By email or to your address, in case you do not have an email available.

items.label: e)
items.title: In what media can the personal and/or sensitive data that you request, where applicable, be reproduced?

revoke.title: You can revoke your consent for the use of your personal and/or sensitive data
revoke.text: You can revoke the consent that, where applicable, you have granted us for the processing of your personal and/or sensitive data. However, it is important to note that not in all cases we will be able to attend to your request or conclude the use immediately, since it is possible that due to some legal obligation we require to continue processing your personal and/or sensitive data. Likewise, you must consider that for certain purposes, the revocation of your consent will imply that we cannot continue providing the service you requested, or the conclusion of your relationship with us. To revoke your consent, you must submit your request through the procedure and means described in the previous section.

limit.title: How can you limit the use or disclosure of your personal information?
limit.text: In order for you to limit the use and disclosure of your personal information, you must submit your request through the procedure and means described in the previous sections.

purposes: Analysis and statistics of our portal;
Improving the service, quality and performance of our portal, and
Offering you new products and services based on your preferences.

Region in which the user is located;

refunds.intro: LATDEV SOLUTIONS S.A. That is why we offer this CircuitoDigital Refund and Returns Policy to establish a procedure and options in the cases that warrant it.

objective.title: Objective
objective.text: The objective of this policy is to establish the guidelines and procedures for refunds and returns of the services offered by CircuitoDigital, guaranteeing the satisfaction of our clients and maintaining high quality standards in our digital solutions.
objective.scope: This policy applies to all digital services offered by CircuitoDigital.

conditions.title: Conditions for Refunds and Returns
conditions.intro: Since the services offered by CircuitoDigital are digital and personalized in nature, refund and return requests will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis. The following situations will be considered eligible for a refund:
items: Serious Technical Failure: If it is demonstrated that the delivered digital service presents serious technical failures that prevent its use and that cannot be resolved within a reasonable period.
Breach of Terms: If CircuitoDigital does not comply with the terms and specifications agreed in the service contract.
conditions.period: Request Period: Refund and return requests must be made within the first 30 calendar days from the date of delivery of the service. Requests made outside this period will not be considered.

procedure.title: Procedure to Request a Refund
items: The client must contact the CircuitoDigital customer service team through the contact means provided on our Site, specifying the reason for the refund request and providing any necessary evidence (such as screenshots, detailed descriptions of the failure, etc.).

Once the request is received, the CircuitoDigital technical support team will evaluate the situation and determine whether the request meets the conditions established in this policy. This process may include the technical review of the delivered digital service.

CircuitoDigital commits to resolving the refund request within a maximum period of 15 business days from the date of receipt of the complete request. The client will be informed of the resolution by email.

If the request is approved, CircuitoDigital will proceed to make the corresponding refund. The refund amount will be calculated based on the cost of the contracted service, discounting any administrative expense or costs incurred in the service delivery process.
The refund of the money will take time to arrive according to your bank's guidelines; otherwise, CircuitoDigital is not responsible for your money being reflected in your bank account.

refundMethod.title: Refund Method
refundMethod.text: Refunds will be made using the same payment method used by the client at the time of contracting the service. Depending on the client's banking entity, processing times may vary.

exclusions.title: Exclusions

items: Change of Mind: If the client simply changes their mind after purchasing the service.
Incorrect Use: If the problem was caused by incorrect use of the service by the client.
Fully Used Services: If the contracted service has been fully used and delivered in accordance with the agreed specifications.
